verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a sandbox or test environment that keeps Stagehand runs away from production data. observe() lets a user validate actions before executing them, but that is a preview or dry-run step, not sandbox isolation. Browserbase regions, persistent contexts and local browser options are browser-hosting choices, not a separate test environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
